summary: Nora's location, online-status and reminder tools now explain their results when they return them, instead of in a long description she read on every message.
details: where_is, where_been, online_now and remind were rewritten to ADR 0015. Their descriptions went from 710, 995, 703 and 842 tokens to 91, 160, 79 and 255.
How to read each status (carry the reading's age, never read coordinates aloud, what 'away' means) now arrives in the result's note, only when that status comes back.
Fixed choices (where_been's arms, online_now's arms, remind's repeat) are enum types, so an invalid value is refused before the tool runs.
